card.title: Recognize Me
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've thanked the wedding guests. What about the person who cooked?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you made the food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why does the programme thank 'the buffet'?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The buffet would like its surname pronounced correctly.

mechanism: A demands public personal recognition beneath an impersonal food-service credit.
confusable: Unlike simply wanting a corrected program, A must make B acknowledge the person responsible.
comparison: D09-b accepts an announcement but specifies surname accuracy; D09-a requests a name within collective engineering credit.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
